analysis_scope: B0 descriptive in-sample Real Train comparison, plus reuse of frozen s2_74B B1/B2 results; no model selection.

baseline_settings.acf: mean per-window demeaned autocorrelation; zero padding 1024; normalize by lag zero; compare lags 1..128
baseline_settings.aggregation: equal subject weight, EO/EC equal inside subject; paired B2-B1 intervals

connectivity.frequency_average: compute estimator per bin, then average
connectivity.graph_metrics: edge MAE, edge r, relative Frobenius, mean connectivity, mean incident weight per node; no thresholding
connectivity.metric: Vinck debiased squared wPLI; DO NOT square it again
connectivity.observations: non-overlap 4-second Train windows, count-matched synthetic indices
connectivity.zero_denominator: undefined, reported; never fill with zero

baseline_settings.connectivity_state_effect: Within-subject EC minus EO matrices; upper-triangle MAE and r of synthetic vs real contrasts
baseline_settings.copying: same-subject/state nearest normalized RMSE + bitwise exact match; no privacy guarantee
baseline_settings.diversity: ratio RMS pairwise distance (synthetic/real); parity at one; not larger-is-better
baseline_settings.fid_status: Not included in this stage; requires a separately frozen, shared and suitable EEG feature extractor.

permutation_entropy.ties: stable index order, tie fraction reported

baseline_settings.reference: Real Train only; all eligible usable windows for full-pool descriptors
baseline_settings.rr_calibration: fixed disjoint TRAIN block halves; nonoverlap windows; equal m for Real A, Real B, B1, B2
baseline_settings.sd_md: mean channel absolute SD difference; SD pooled over windows and time (resting-state adaptation)

bandt2002.title: Permutation Entropy: A Natural Complexity Measure for Time Series
bandt2002.use: Ordinal permutation entropy, fixed order 3 and delay 1.

barry2007.title: EEG differences between eyes-closed and eyes-open resting conditions
barry2007.use: Bandpower, EO/EC and spatial effects; numerical error metrics are project adaptations.

finn2015.title: Functional connectome fingerprinting: identifying individuals using patterns of brain connectivity
finn2015.use: Identification concept only; original modality fMRI. Our log-bandpower fingerprint is an EEG/project adaptation.

hardmeier2014.title: Reproducibility of Functional Connectivity and Graph Measures Based on the Phase Lag Index (PLI) and Weighted Phase Lag Index (wPLI) Derived from High Resolution EEG
hardmeier2014.use: Motivates resting-EEG connectivity and within-real calibration; not reproducing long-term ICC.

hartmann2018.title: EEG-GAN: Generative adversarial networks for electroencephalograhic (EEG) brain signals
hartmann2018.use: Sliced Wasserstein and nearest-real-sample diagnostics; not a formal privacy test.

hjorth1970.title: EEG analysis based on time domain properties
hjorth1970.use: Activity, mobility and complexity; derivatives here are finite differences per sample.

klein2024.title: Synthesizing EEG Signals from Event-Related Potential Paradigms with Conditional Diffusion Models
klein2024.use: SWD family, SD-MD, condition-wise evaluation, real-real reference; pooled SD and resting-state adaptations explicit.

silveira2026.title: Interpretable metrics for evaluating fidelity, diversity, and privacy in synthetic EEG data
silveira2026.use: Complementary descriptors, real-real calibration and nearest-neighbour caution. No composite score or borrowed thresholds.

vinck2011.title: An improved index of phase-synchronization for electrophysiological data in the presence of volume-conduction, noise and sample-size bias

baseline_settings.spectral_comparison: 1-40 Hz; mean linear PSD then 10*log10; bandpower median of per-window dB

swd.representation: flattened 19x512 fixed Train-z; same projections for both generators and RR

baseline_settings.units: Recover uV with frozen Train scaler; normalized z for SWD/covariance/nearest-neighbour
